skill.displayName: Shopee-选品决策专家 | 青虎AI

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Shopee market-research workflow that uses a Qinghu API token and exports report data, with no evidence of hidden execution, persistence, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: Reading QINGHU_TOKEN or QHKIT_TOKEN and sending authorized requests to www.iqinghu.com is proportionate for this third-party API integration, but it is sensitive credential use.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact consists of a single Markdown SKILL.md file and no executable installer, bundled script, dependency, or remote code retrieval mechanism was present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill clearly names the API endpoint, required authorization header, paid-tool workflow, consent before tool calls, and a 10-call-per-turn limit; it also instructs use of environment tokens when available, which users should understand before installation.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs automatic spreadsheet export for larger result sets and reuse of cached local file paths, which is purpose-aligned for report delivery but can leave local business-data artifacts behind.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The requested capabilities fit the stated purpose: it calls Qinghu Shopee data APIs to build a market, competitor, product, and keyword report.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to use Qinghu's Shopee data service. Expect the agent to use a Qinghu API key from QINGHU_TOKEN/QHKIT_TOKEN or one you provide, make paid API calls after confirmation, and create local exported report files for larger datasets; clean up exported files if they contain sensitive business data.
llm.findings:
[SQP-2] expected: The API token concern is supported by SKILL.md line 29, but the endpoint and token mechanism are explicitly disclosed and required for the Qinghu API workflow; this is a user-awareness note rather than evidence of malicious or hidden behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: The export and cached-file concern is supported by SKILL.md lines 153-155, but report export is part of the declared data-delivery behavior and no unbounded background persistence or unrelated data access is shown.
